title: security(rbac): RBAC v2 enforcement + KMS region residency controls with audit logging
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Enforce RBAC v2 region pinning for KMS-backed keys; add audit logging for residency policy decisions; configurable rollout via feature flag. Backwards compatible config defaults to audit-only mode.
description: Motivation: Enforce KMS region residency and RBAC v2 policy decisions at request time to meet customer data-residency SLAs and provide stronger audit trails. This PR implements enforcement hooks in the RBAC v2 enforcer for KMS-backed resources, plumbs residency checks through the auth layer, and emits structured audit events for decisions (allow/deny/override). Scope: 1) RBAC v2 enforcer: add residency constraint checks and an enforce/ audit-only runtime flag. 2) KMS integration: verify key region metadata and expose residency metadata to the auth layer. 3) Audit logging: structured events for all residency-related decisions, with extra context for admin rollbacks. 4) Config & docs: new policy YAML fields (residency: {regions:[], mode: audit|enforce}), helm values, and customer-facing docs. Testing: unit + integration tests for policy evaluation and an e2e that exercises cross-region key rejection. Rollout: default is audit-only; ops can enable enforce for a Linear rollout (ENG-4822). Related: SEC-731, SUP-924.

review_comments: Alex Chen (reviewer): Overall looks solid. A few questions: 1) How do we ensure this doesn't block existing customers when feature flag flips? 2) Can you add a canary rollout section in docs?

Priya Kapoor (author): Reply: Default behavior remains audit-only. Enforce is behind feature flag 'rbac.residency.enforce' and currently not set in prod helm values. Added canary guidance in docs (see docs/security/rbac_v2_kms_residency.md).

Diego Ramos (reviewer): Please add an integration test that simulates a request with a mismatched key region to ensure we log correct decision reason. Also, consider logging the policy id used for the decision for easier debugging.
Priya Kapoor (author): Added tests/integration/test_kms_residency.py and included policy_id in structured audit payload. Expanded test coverage to include audit-only vs enforce modes.

Maya Singh (security lead): Two remaining asks: pad the audit payload with minimal PII-redaction notes, and ensure KMS metadata fetch is cached to avoid per-request latency. Also confirm KMS call is retried per our HTTP client policy.

Priya Kapoor (author): Implemented a simple async cache for key metadata with 30s TTL and added redaction flag and client retry behavior. Benchmarked: median latency increase under 2ms for auth path in our perf cluster.

merge_summary: Squash-merged after reviewer approvals. Final change set includes enforcement toggle behind feature flag; audit events for residency decisions; docs and helm value updates. No migrations required.
notes_for_operators: The feature is off by default (audit-only). To enable enforcement set rbac.residency.enforce=true in your helm values and ensure KMS key metadata is available for all keys in use. Monitor the residency.audit_events metric and the rbac.residency.denied counter during rollout.
